comparisons.name: note-light
comparisons.description: The yellow note of Stickies, key, with its title strip, widgets and text, Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: note-light-masked
comparisons.description: As note-light with the lines of text (and the insertion point under the last one) masked, to score the note, its strip and its widgets alone: the text is set in a stand-in for Helvetica off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: note-dark
comparisons.description: The yellow note with Finder frontmost, so not key: no strip and no widgets, Dark Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: note-dark-masked
comparisons.description: As note-dark with the lines of text masked: the text is set in a stand-in for Helvetica off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: top-edge-light
comparisons.description: The top edge of the key yellow note over the blue note, Aqua: the shadow on a flat colour, the strip and the zoom box. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: top-edge-dark
comparisons.description: The top edge of the yellow note, not key, over the blue note, Dark Aqua: the shadow and the 0.5 pt outline. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: left-edge-light
comparisons.description: The left edge of the key yellow note over the blue note, Aqua: the shadow beside the note.

comparisons.name: left-edge-dark
comparisons.description: The left edge of the yellow note, not key, over the blue note, Dark Aqua: the shadow and the 0.5 pt outline beside the note.

comparisons.name: states-key
comparisons.description: A blue note as the key note over a yellow note collapsed to its title bar, Aqua. No screenshot shows either.

comparisons.name: states-not-key
comparisons.description: The same notes in a window that is not key, Dark Aqua: the strips take the body colour and the widgets are gone.
